steps.instruction: The browser is currently on a Grafana dashboard's Settings > General page (dashboard UID dfwq7fnd2d81sa, currently titled 'new-dashboard'). Fill the dashboard Title field with exactly '{{runid}} Bench Dashboard' and save the dashboard (click 'Save dashboard' in the header, confirm any save dialog/toast). Then verify the title took effect and report the dashboard URL and the title shown.

On the Grafana dashboard '{{runid}} Bench Dashboard' (UID {{02-verify.url.p1}}), add a new 'Text' panel. Set its title to exactly '{{runid}} Notes' and set its text content to include the runid, e.g. 'Notes for run {{runid}}'. Then save the dashboard (explicit Save, confirm the saved toast). Verify both panels are present afterwards and report the titles of all panels on the dashboard and the text panel's content.

On the Grafana dashboard '{{runid}} Bench Dashboard' (UID {{02-verify.url.p1}}), do two things and save: (1) Add the tag 'bench' to the dashboard (via Settings > General > Tags, or the dashboard settings). (2) Set the dashboard's time range to the last 6 hours (use the time range picker in the top right and choose 'Last 6 hours', or set it in Settings). Then explicitly save the dashboard and confirm the saved toast. Report the tags shown and the time range shown in the top-right picker after saving.

On the Grafana dashboard '{{runid}} Bench Dashboard' (UID {{02-verify.url.p1}}), set the dashboard's auto-refresh interval to '1m'. Use the refresh interval picker in the top-right toolbar (next to the time range picker) and select '1m' from the dropdown; if it's not available there, add '1m' to the Auto refresh intervals list in Settings > General and set it. Then explicitly save the dashboard and confirm the saved toast. After saving, reload the dashboard page and report what the refresh picker shows and the dashboard URL.

recorded.refresh_picker_aria: Choose refresh time interval with current interval 1 minute selected
